remarks: Welcome to this beautifully Colonial updated duplex front unit home has 2 spacious bedrooms and one and a half modern bathrooms. Perfect for those seeking comfort and convenience. Located on quiet street near, shopping, dining, downtown Stamford, and public transportation.   Highlights: - 2 large bedrooms with ample closet space, and hardwood floors. -Open main level floor with a great large living room to dining room. The bright and spacious living are with hardwood floors.   - Kitchen with granite counters, cabinets, stainless appliances including dishwasher.   -Upstairs are 2 large bedrooms and 1 full bath with whirlpool tub.   -Laundry located in basement with great space of storage.  - New floor in the basement.
